title: Intelligent In-Vehicle Scenario Orchestration Agent System
summary: Changan reports that its vehicle agent reduces scenario-configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. Safety and environmental benefits remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Changan reports that its vehicle-agent demonstration reduces scenario-configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. Development continues. Safety and environmental benefits remain unmeasured.
purpose: Let drivers coordinate vehicle functions through natural-language commands.
developer: Chongqing Changan Automobile, with Ali Cloud collaboration

ratings.reason: The source states that scenario-configuration tasks fall from minutes to seconds. This is a convenience and time-saving claim, without an independently measured user study.
Manufacturers are intended to integrate services more easily; no organizational development gain is measured.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 5: Intelligent In-Vehicle Scenario Orchestration Agent System

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Automotive instruction data and vehicle-service interfaces

headline: Voice commands orchestrate in-vehicle functions
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
